title: The design of everyday things
author: Don Norman
description: The Design of Everyday Things is a book by Don Norman that explores the principles of design and how they can be applied to create user-friendly products. The book covers topics such as affordances, signifiers, feedback, and constraints, and provides insights into how to design products that are intuitive and easy to use.
readreason: I want to learn more about user experience design.
